title: Normalized unimodular rows are unique in their quotient classes
statement: Let R be any commutative ring with identity, and let U = {(r,s) ∈ R² | ∃ x,y ∈ R, xr + ys = 1}. For v,w ∈ U define rel(v,w) to mean ∃ u ∈ Rˣ, u v₁ = w₁ and u v₂ = w₂. Call v normalized when v₁ = 1 or when v₁ is not a unit and v₂ = 1. For any normalized v,w ∈ U, their images under Quot.mk rel are equal if and only if v = w. No nontriviality or local-ring hypothesis is required.
lean_statement: ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R], let U := {v : R × R // ∃ x y : R, x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1}; let rel : U → U → Prop := fun v w => ∃ u : Rˣ, (u : R) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : R) * v.1.2 = w.1.2; ∀ v w : U, (v.1.1 = 1 ∨ (¬ IsUnit v.1.1 ∧ v.1.2 = 1)) → (w.1.1 = 1 ∨ (¬ IsUnit w.1.1 ∧ w.1.2 = 1)) → (Quot.mk rel v = Quot.mk rel w ↔ v = w)
